messages:
Lina (Partnerships): kickoff thread for cloud marketplace listing (AWS/GCP/Azure). need a lightweight checklist: IAM/service accounts, SKU naming, trial mechanics, legal signoff, and marketplace assets (icons/docs). aiming to get sandbox listing into staging next week.

Omar (Legal): noted. i'll focus on publisher agreement, indemnity, and DPA gaps. any PII/data residency claims we should anticipate?

Nina (Product): product constraints: trial = 14d with token cap + optional paid upgrade. proposed SKU slug pattern: `redwood-<product>-<tier>` (e.g., redwood-core-pro). we should also decide whether reserved GPU offering appears as a separate SKU or as a plan add-on.

Hiro (Cloud Eng): infra notes: AWS needs a cross-account role for the marketplace publisher; GCP needs a service account with iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator for the partner flow; Azure requires a publisher registration + offer resource ID. snippets: 
```
# gcloud: create service account
gcloud iam service-accounts create redwood-marketplace-sa --display-name="Redwood Marketplace"
```
And minimal AWS trust policy example: `sts:AssumeRole` with marketplace principal.

Sam (DevRel): i'll prepare quickstart with terraform + example tenant setup. request: can we get a staging tenant with 3 test seats and sample dataset? infra-bot -> ticket?

infra-bot: created ticket MKT-4888: staging-tenant-provision (assigned to Hiro). estimated 48h.

Omar (Legal): quick question re: Azure Marketplace: they sometimes require a regional EULA and specific wording around telemetry. @Nina pls confirm if telemetry will be opt-in.

Nina (Product): telemetry will be opt-in. doc will enumerate metrics (token usage, latencies, error rates) and privacy-safe hashes only. will prepare EEA addendum text for EU/UK.

Hiro (Cloud Eng): FYI we should also publish AMI/VM images for AWS and GCP where appropriate, plus a container image for private offers. naming convention: `redwood/inference:marketplace-<version>-<arch>`. ARM builds may be optional at launch.

Lina (Partnerships): good call. decision checkpoints: 1) legal signoff on DPA/EULA (Omar, due Thu COB) 2) SKU and trial doc (Nina, due Tue) 3) cloud artifacts + IAM roles + staging tenant (Hiro, due Wed) 4) devrel quickstart + demo walkthrough (Sam, due next Mon). i'll book a review on Wed 9am PT.

Sam (DevRel): can we surface pricing visibility in the quickstart? add mock billing responses and sample invoice line items to demo flow.

Nina (Product): yes, include mock invoices and a toggle for trial->paid conversion flow.

Lina (Partnerships): thanks team. i'll attach a small spreadsheet with SKU mapping and link to the assets folder: https://intra.redwood/marketplace/assets. drop comments in the doc and i'll update before Wed. :white_check_mark:
